positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Develop hot-fixes and patches for bugs in supported versions of the product. Focus on scale issues and distributed environments for enterprise customers' deployments of the product. Participate in project management meeting with and without the customers. Read a lot of other developers’ code. 
•	Perform root cause analysis and debug issues – sometimes in front of customers
•	Gain keen awareness of the importance of readable, maintainable code and minimizing technical debt
•	Chase elusive bugs in unfamiliar systems
•	Insight into the difference between developers’ and customers’ expectations of the product

Continuation of the previous position after moving to the United States (permanent residence – green card).

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Work in a company that develops firewall monitoring and policy change management tools. Responsible for maintaining all of the company's products. Personally responsible for a queue of bug issues, that spans multiple products and technologies. Prioritize tasks for 2 alternating developers. Investigate issues and implement bug fixes. Interface with different company branches outside RnD: Support, Product and Sales. Analyze and solve issues live, in front of customers during remote control web sessions.
•	Produce "same day" fixes for enterprise customers and urgent POCs
•	Solve scale related issues that are usually missed during the usual dev and QA cycle
•	Technologies: Perl, Java 8, Spring MVC, PostgreSQL

positions.title: PHP Developer
positions.description:
Develop a web app that presents a unified dashboard for multiple web applications. Implement PHP client integrations to many and diverse web APIs (GoogleAds, Facebook, AWS, etc.). Use open source SDKs when available, and implement my own when not. Experience with implementing OAuth 1.0a, OAuth 2 and other authentication methods. Research and read the documentation of dozens of RESTful APIs.
•	Develop clients that work with many REST APIs
•	Received ownership of all backend development after 3 months

positions.title: PHP and C Developer
positions.description:
Develop a BI system from the ground up. Initial design and development of the front-end code base with jQuery, and training, guiding and leading another developer who further developed the front-end code. Implement raw sensor data analysis to provide meaningful Business Intelligence (BI) data. Develop an RS485 client for a proprietary communications protocol.
•	Remote work (from home)
•	Design of MySQL database and all the queries
•	Independently build a complete system, from polling the sensors to displaying to the client. Installed, working and stable
•	Implement all PHP code including data processing and AJAX calls
•	Train and lead another developer
•	Research and deploy servers and databases on AWS
•	Technologies: C, PHP, MySQL, jQuery

positions.title: Embedded Software Developer
positions.description:
Sole C developer of a startup company. Learn microcontroller programming on the job. Create the data acquisition part of an electricity monitoring product. Implement polling clients using Modbus and other protocols. Implement a custom communication protocol using Zigbee and RS485 between microcontrollers and a router. Flash, setup, install and configure OpenWRT Linux on routers. Use Git for version control. Research and choose which hardware to use. Read protocol documentation. High level of freedom and independence as sole developer in this project.
•	Remote work (from home)
•	Optimize code to fit the limitations of bare metal MSP430 microcontrollers
•	Technologies: C, RT Embedded, Bash, Linux, Modbus, Zigbee
